description.value: Salesloft describes itself as a predictive revenue system. It captures revenue signals across a company's tools, separates the ones that drive outcomes from noise, and turns them into next actions for sales teams.
Salesloft describes itself as 'The Leading Predictive Revenue System,' helping revenue teams create, convert, and grow revenue.
US sales engagement platform. It began with sales development tools and has since expanded to serve the entire sales organization.
A sales engagement platform. It began with sales development tools and has since expanded to serve entire sales organizations.
Atlanta-based sales software company, now positioned as a revenue orchestration platform.

product_description.value: For account teams: Cadence (sales engagement), Conversation Intelligence, Deals (deal management), and Rhythm (workflow prioritization). For executive and RevOps teams: Clari Forecast, Inspect (pipeline inspection), Revenue Cadences, and Analytics. Also Signals, AI Agents, Consulting Services, and a partner marketplace.

Cadence, Conversation Intelligence, Deals, and Rhythm for account teams; Clari Forecast, Inspect, Revenue Cadences, and Analytics for executive and RevOps teams; plus Signals (a live layer that feeds a Data and AI engine that triggers AI agents), AI Agents, and Consulting Services.
A sales engagement platform. Through the Drift acquisition, its products also include the Drift platform.
Advanced analytics, sales forecasting, sales automation, sales coaching, deal management, revenue intelligence, sales engagement, and conversation intelligence. Its AI layer is described as Rhythm.

business_model_description.value: Sells B2B software subscriptions to revenue teams.

customer_description.value: Cites more than 4,000 sales teams. Industries served: High Tech, Logistics, Manufacturing, Medical Software & Devices, Professional Services, Telecommunications, and Financial Services. Named customer: Wrike.
Cites more than 4,000 sales teams. Named customer: Wrike. Other customers are quoted from sales operations and sales leadership roles.
Targets sales professionals, marketing teams, and revenue operations leaders. One vendor profile claims more than 5,000 customers including Google, 3M, IBM, Shopify, Square, and Cisco.
